description: Get insolvency and restructuring proceedings of a Polish company from the National Debtors Register (KRZ). Identify the company by name, KRS number or company tax number (NIP).

krs.description: KRS number of the company in the Polish National Court Register (10 digits).

name.description: Company name, used when the KRS or NIP is not known.

nip.description: Polish company tax number (NIP) of the business, 10 digits.

name: get_company_debt_registry
title: Get National Debt Register (KRZ)
